cohort: The study included 311 pregnant women admitted for threatened preterm labor at two regional maternity hospitals.
finding: Higher levels of neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR) and systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) were independently associated with an increased risk of preterm birth in women with threatened preterm labor.
gest_age: Preterm birth (<37 weeks), early preterm birth (<34 weeks), late preterm birth (34-36.6 weeks), and gestational age at admission were assessed.
